TyraelSalvation.name: Salvation
TyraelSalvation.description: Increase the Shield amount Tyrael gains from Righteousness by 40% and heal Tyrael for 140 (+4% per level) Health if his Shield is destroyed. Does not increase the Shield amount gained by allies.

TyraelJusticeForAll.name: Justice for All
TyraelJusticeForAll.description: Increase the Shield applied to allies by Righteousness to 80% of the Shield gained by Tyrael.

TyraelArdentRestoration.name: Ardent Restoration
TyraelArdentRestoration.description: Dealing damage to a Hero heals Tyrael for 20 (+4% per level) Health over 5 seconds. Dealing damage resets this timer, and the heal amount stacks up to 10 times. Quest: Every Regeneration Globe gathered increases this heal amount by 1%.

TyraelStalwartAngel.name: Stalwart Angel
TyraelStalwartAngel.description: Gain 25 Armor while El'druin's Might is active, and for 3 seconds after teleporting.

TyraelElDruinsMightBoundByLaw.name: Bound by Law
TyraelElDruinsMightBoundByLaw.description: Heroes hit by El'druin's Might heal Tyrael for 3% of his maximum Health. Tyrael's Basic Attacks against enemies Slowed by El'druin's Might increase the Slow duration by 1 second, up to 4 seconds.

TyraelDivineVigor.name: Divine Vigor
TyraelDivineVigor.description: If Smite hits an enemy, Tyrael's Basic Attacks within the next 4 seconds heal for 70% of the damage dealt.

TyraelMasteryRighteousnessReciprocate.name: Reciprocate
TyraelMasteryRighteousnessReciprocate.description: When Tyrael's Shield from Righteousness expires or is destroyed, it deals 190 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.

TyraelMasteryPurgeEvil.name: Purge Evil
TyraelMasteryPurgeEvil.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Smite increases Tyrael's Basic Attack damage by 60% for 4 seconds.

TyraelMasterySwiftRetribution.name: Swift Retribution
TyraelMasterySwiftRetribution.description: Smite grants 20% more Movement Speed and also grants 25% Attack Speed for 2 seconds.

TyraelHeroicAbilityJudgement.name: Judgment
TyraelHeroicAbilityJudgement.description: After 0.75 seconds, charge an enemy Hero, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds. Nearby enemies are knocked away and take 75 (+4% per level) damage.

TyraelHeroicAbilitySanctification.name: Sanctification
TyraelHeroicAbilitySanctification.description: After 0.5 seconds create a field of holy energy that makes allied Heroes Invulnerable. Lasts 3 seconds.

TyraelMasteryElDruinsMightSwordOfJustice.name: Sword of Justice
TyraelMasteryElDruinsMightSwordOfJustice.description: Upon teleporting using El'druin's Might, El'druin swaps places with Tyrael, and El'druin's Might can be reactivated to teleport an additional time.

TyraelMasteryHolyGround.name: Holy Ground
TyraelMasteryHolyGround.description: Create a ring for 3 seconds that blocks enemies from entering the area teleported to using El'druin's Might.

TyraelMasteryLawAndOrder.name: Law and Order
TyraelMasteryLawAndOrder.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Smite reduces the cooldown of Righteousness by 1 second. Each allied Hero Shielded by Righteousness increases the damage of the next Smite by 35%.

TyraelHoradricReforging.name: Horadric Reforging
TyraelHoradricReforging.description: Tyrael's Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of El'druin's Might by 2 seconds.

TyraelBurningHalo.name: Burning Halo
TyraelBurningHalo.description: Both Tyrael and El'druin deal 18 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Teleporting increases this damage from Tyrael by 150% for 2 seconds.

TyraelSmiteTheWicked.name: Smite the Wicked
TyraelSmiteTheWicked.description: While El'druin's Might is active, and for 2 seconds after teleporting, Smite's cooldown recharges 125% faster.

TyraelMasteryJudgmentAngelofJustice.name: Angel of Justice
TyraelMasteryJudgmentAngelofJustice.description: Increases the cast range of Judgment by 50%, and reduces the cooldown by 40 seconds.

TyraelMasterySanctificationHolyArena.name: Holy Arena
TyraelMasterySanctificationHolyArena.description: Increase the duration of Sanctification by 1 second and increase the damage of allies inside by 25%.

TyraelSealOfElDruin.name: Seal of El'druin
TyraelSealOfElDruin.description: Using a Basic Ability grants 50% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

TyraelDefenseOfTheAngels.name: Defense of the Angels
TyraelDefenseOfTheAngels.description: Activate to gain 50 Armor for 3 seconds. Each time Tyrael damages an enemy Hero with a Basic Attack or Basic Ability, increase the duration of this Armor bonus by 0.5 seconds.
